description: React component for rendering a row in the admin console's group details table, managing team and channel memberships with role assignment and collapse functionality.

classes.name: GroupTeamsAndChannelsRow
classes.description: React component class for a row representing a group, team, or channel with role management and collapse features.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Handles removal of the item, triggers onRemoveItem callback.

methods.name: changeRoles
methods.description: Toggles the role between member and admin.

methods.name: toggleCollapse
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of the row.

methods.name: displayAssignedRolesDropdown
methods.description: Renders dropdown for role assignment based on current role and type.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the table row with icons, role dropdown, and action buttons.
